findings: Fingerprint::variants is [[u64;4];8]; examined comparison APIs have no textual hexadecimal parser.
Low-information images are exposed through Comparison::informative; visual candidates do not imply exact normalized pixel equality.

Cache has fixed binary record size, magic, BLAKE3 checksum, duplicate-key/trailing-byte and floating-point validity checks. These cache observations are source inspection only in this audit, not a fresh execution of cache tests.
scope: Five actual image information controls, inspected pixels/cache contract; not exhaustive public API parsing, full cache fuzzing or semantic negative precision.
